purpose: Record approved additions to migrated simulation drivers without rewriting the historical PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json.

files.change: Optional render_figures flag, default true. All numerical admission checks unchanged.

Add competitive_fixed_efficiency_bgp initial-stock rule and roundoff-only cache validation for that rule. Add an optional track_transition_midpoint flag, default true, so growth-reversal exports can omit labor-share transition-date statistics. Existing initial-stock rules, numerical equations, solver, and admission tolerances are unchanged.

Remove the mesh-point column from the numerical-accuracy table and clarify that horizons are measured in years. This records the presentation-only change in commit b436cf5; numerical calculations and admission criteria are unchanged.
